materialization.encoding: UTF-8 without BOM; LF line endings
materialization.population_serialization: JSON object base_population, two-space indentation, ensure_ascii=false, one final LF
materialization.registry_serialization: Join base_registry_lines with LF and append one final LF
materialization.knowledge_files: Create every base_population.knowledge_paths member with default_knowledge_content, then apply base_content_overrides
materialization.case_semantics: Each case starts from the complete base independently. Apply its changes in order. No case inherits changes from another case.
materialization.row_rendering: An array of eleven strings renders as '| ' + cells joined with ' | ' + ' |'. replace_registry_row_cells replaces the row matching the specified id only. append_registry_row_cells appends inside Registry before the next heading.
materialization.output_expectations: Expected objects are hand-authored semantic projections, not observed JSON from an implementation. Existing stable finding-id names are distinguished from proposed interface names below. Per-source citing_files and used_by are sets of exact lane-relative paths, not mention counts.

finding_id_authority.exit_split_note: Exit 0/1/2 is preregistered. Missing-readable-row is expected mismatch/1. The exact 1-versus-2 split for malformed registry rows and missing knowledge bytes is a design choice here, not a claim of an already specified implementation. In those cases the invariant minimum is a typed non-clean result and no silently reduced population. Population-corruption IDs are proposals; do not label a naming-only difference an instrument defect.

base_population.note: Literal reference coverage only, not semantic endorsement; all standalone mentions count, even historical/corrective references. Additional used-by lesson paths permitted. Population fixed at base; new round28 knowledge excluded.

planned_single_mutant.behavior_point: The iteration over frozen source IDs after registry parsing
planned_single_mutant.pristine_semantics: Visit every ID in frozen source_ids; when absent from parsed Registry, emit source_missing for that exact ID.
planned_single_mutant.mutant_semantics: Visit only frozen source_ids intersected with successfully parsed registry IDs, omitting absence before finding generation.
planned_single_mutant.smallest_change: One iterator/filter expression, not regex, parser, fixtures, output renderer, or expected data
planned_single_mutant.expected_pristine_detector: Control exit0 with thirteen source records; witness exit1 with source_missing:S038 and thirteen requested IDs, twelve present registry rows.
planned_single_mutant.expected_mutant_detector: Control may still pass; witness loses source_missing:S038 and/or silently reports twelve sources. Detector must fail on either result.
planned_single_mutant.run_protocol: On one assigned isolated scratch instrument copy only: save exact original bytes+SHA256; run the same bounded CLI detector and record stdout/stderr/exits; apply M1 only; run identical detector; restore exact saved bytes in finally even on detector error; verify restored hash equals original; run identical detector again. Baseline or restored detector failure is inconclusive, never a kill. No production tree or sibling worktree writes.
planned_single_mutant.restoration_evidence: No instrument bytes were opened, copied, mutated, or executed in this assignment; before/mutated/restored hashes are intentionally not invented.
